_doc: REGRESSION-CORPUS concept-query recall: measured on the named regression topics in registry/regression_recall_topics.json, against each topic's pinned known-eligible set (pooled primary trials + eligible-declared-absent trials with PMIDs). Published whatever it is. engine_sha pins the engine that was measured; verify_all refuses the standard if harness/acquisition.py changes without a new entry here. This is not prospective validation.
validation_status: REGRESSION_CORPUS — not prospective validation: all 32 corpus topics are disqualified as held-out (exposed through audits, URLs, commit history); measured on the 5 corpus topics that had zero contact with engine tuning
